Maths earns the upgrades

Make progress feel personal.

Earn experience, spend earned credits on kit, choose a position and unlock in-game club offers. Early levels arrive quickly; later levels take more practice. Big club offers also need varied facts, several practice days and later recall.

  • Custom block-style characters, kit numbers and equipment
  • Different kicks, power shots and fireballs after accurate streaks
  • A shared-device squad league using real saved players
  • Year promotion based on learning evidence, not a shopping balance

A few useful answers

Parent guide
Does it replace a teacher or school curriculum?

No. It is supplementary practice for core skills. Discussion, practical work and teacher assessment remain important.

How does a player move up a year?

They need broad match-fit practice evidence, recorded practical checks and a successful promotion match. An academy promotion is a game milestone, not an official school placement.

Are the leaderboards public?

No. The squad league compares eligible saved matches from players on the same browser. Nicknames and answers are not uploaded to a leaderboard service.

Do credits cost money?

No. One credit is earned for every 10 XP. Credits buy cosmetic items, with no random prizes or paid boosts.
